title: SEC1: duplicate validate_blob_id logic
notes: kith-chat/message.rs has its own validate_blob_id function duplicating BlobStore::validate_blob_id. kith-peer calls kith_attach::BlobStore::validate_blob_id directly. Two separate copies of identical logic; a future rule change must be applied in two places. The message.rs comment even calls this out: 'no dep on kith-attach — inline.' Risk: rules diverge silently. Fix: expose validate_blob_id as a pub fn in kith-core or have message.rs dep on kith-attach like kith-peer does.
